title: Non-sensitive provenance, lineage, correlation, and replay identity
objective: Implement complete non-sensitive source, snapshot, identity, feature, model, policy, route, evaluator, and outcome lineage with correlated events and replay-addressable identities.
business_reason: Every synthetic route decision must be explainable, independently reconstructable, and replay-addressable without exposing protected payloads before recovery and adversarial work can begin.
inputs: CONTRACT-001 canonical version, clock, hash, lineage, and replay contracts
SECURITY-001 sensitive-log exclusion and live-disabled defaults
existing synthetic lineage schema, evaluator, evidence, and known-bad fixtures
assumptions: all inputs and events remain synthetic
general lineage records contain no secrets, PII, or protected-match details
live permissions and external effects remain false
evaluator: inspect and preserve the legacy observability evaluator boundary
freeze an additive independent evaluator before material implementation
reject missing as-of, version, hash, correlation, replay identity, lineage edge, and sensitive-log mutations
known_bad_cases: required lineage node or edge dropped
protected-account or sensitive detail written to general logs
acceptance: every synthetic decision is traceable from source through outcome
every recorded artifact binds version, clock, hash, owner, and lineage
correlated events and replay identities are deterministic
live permissions and external effects remain false
rollback: Revert the event or lineage version while preserving the prior manifest reader and historical synthetic events; disable affected telemetry and continue to exclude sensitive payloads.
stop_budget: Remain synthetic and non-influencing; preserve legacy evaluator hashes, keep live permissions false, and do not claim production telemetry, durability, recovery, or operational completeness.
